description: Download an export bundle for an app — source code, percher.toml, env keys, custom domains, deploy history, migration README, and (for PocketBase apps) a pb_data.zip + schema.json. Writes the .tar.gz to the working directory and returns the local path. Env VALUES are not included; the user must use the dashboard's Settings → Export and confirm their password to include encrypted env values. The download link is single-use and expires in 15 minutes — call this tool fresh each time the user asks to export.
name: percher_export
